```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(mgcv)
library(modelr)
library(p8105.datasets)

set.seed(1)
```

```{r}
n_samp = 250

sim_df_const = 
  tibble(
    x = rnorm(n_samp, 1, 1),
    error = rnorm(n_samp, 0, 1),
    y = 2 + 3 * x + error
  )

sim_df_const |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth()
```

```{r}
sim_df_nonconst = 
  sim_df_const |> 
  mutate(
    error = error * .75 * x, #outcome variance depends on the predictor now (because x). this leads to nonconstant variance
    y = 2 + 3 * x + error 
  )

sim_df_nonconst |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") #CI should be much bigger at tails where there is large variance - fix this 
```

Fix the regressions 

```{r}
sim_df_const |> 
  lm(y ~ x, data = _) |> 
  broom::tidy() |> 
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```

Nonconstant 

```{r}
sim_df_nonconst |> 
  lm(y ~ x, data = _) |> 
  broom::tidy() |> 
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```
